programme.title: Mahalske priče
programme.desc: Sarajevski podkast "Mahalske priče" kroz zanimljive teme i dozu humora donosi razgovore u kojima gosti otkrivaju svoje priče, iskustva i manje poznate detalje. Gostuju poznata imena iz svijeta kulture, sporta i filma.

programme.title: Mobil Auto
programme.desc: Emisija koja je prava poslastica za sve ljubitelje automobila. U ovoj informativnoj emisiji kolažnog tipa saznajemo sve aktuelne novosti o automobilskom tržištu kod nas i u celom svetu.

programme.title: Klan
programme.desc: Ubistvo velikog mafijaškog bosa, odrazilo se na celo podzemlje. Svi bi hteli da zauzmu njegovo mesto. Dvojica provincijalaca, brzo napreduju na mafijaškoj lestvici i uspostavljaju novi poslovni model. Šok i Paša uspostavljajući taj model, u svoje poslove upliću sve oko sebe.

programme.title: Hype Style
programme.desc: Fokus ovog kratkog formata jeste lajfstajl holivudskih ličnosti prikazan kroz različite kategorije i sfere njihovih života.

programme.title: Leto bez mrlje
programme.desc: "Leto bez mrlje" je humoristična serija u formi sitcoma s elementima telenovele, smeštena na otok Rab, koji svojom lepotom i šarmom postaje neizostavan lik ove tople, duhovite i vizuelno atraktivne priče. Radnja prati brata i sestru – Beograđane Luku i Anđelu – kojima je njihova ekscentrična baka obećala u nasleđe ostaviti kuću na Rabu. No, uslov je jednostavan samo na papiru: tokom celog leta moraju kuću uspešno iznajmljivati turistima bez ijedne negativne recenzije. U praksi, to znači svakodnevno suočavanje s nizom nepredvidivih gostiju, kulturoloških razlika, ljubavnih zavrzlama, tajni, podvala i urnebesnih nesporazuma. Uz sve to, tu je i bakina dodatna "ostavština" – strogi butler Stipe koji je s kućom došao kao bonus i čija prisutnost unosi dodatnu napetost i zabavu u svakodnevicu mladih domaćina.

programme.title: Džesi i Vilenjak
programme.desc: Inspirisana škotskom legendom, ova komedija prati ludorije usamljenog šumskog vilenjaka Gilija Dua koji postaje prijatelj s devojkom izgubljenom u šumi. Kada majka neočekivano dođe po nju i odvede je, utučeni Gili kreće u potragu da pronađe svoju izgubljenu drugaricu. Godinama kasnije, u gradu, Gili upoznaje Džesi, smelu tinejdžerku rešenu da pridobije naklonost svoje uspešne majke tako što će postati poznata frizerka. Kada Džesi otkrije da Gili ima dar za oblikovanje frizura, oni sklapaju jedinstveno partnerstvo koje izaziva haos u šik frizerskom salonu i dovodi Džesi do slave.

programme.title: Aviondžije
programme.desc: Sitkom koji prati urnebesne avanture buntovnih stjuarta i pilota, pod nazivom Aviondžije, u režiji Aleksandra Savića i Dušana Popovića, prva je serija Hype production doo. Svaka epizoda prati let u neki novi grad na kojem se posada susreće sa novim neobičnim putnicima i najrazličitijim peripetijama i opasnostima koje život među oblacima donosi. Kroz brojne doživljaje na različitim krajevima sveta naši junaci pokazuju i svoje drugo lice. Član posade Macan se zaljubljuje u devojku kojoj se najmanje nadao, stjuardesa Nina pronalazi svog milionera samo da bi se zapitala da li je on taj koji će je usrećiti, a najzaljubljeniji članovi posade Dana i Mile prolaze sve turbulencije svoje tajne ljubavi da bi ih na kraju puta dočekalo neočekivano razrešenje.

programme.title: Opa Show
programme.desc: Nastavak kultne emisije "Prslook again". Gosti Sandra Markovića iz nedelje u nedelju će biti brojne ličnosti iz sveta kulture, zabave i sporta. U opuštenoj atmosferi oni će odgovarati na pitanja o svojim karijerima, ali i privatnom životu.

programme.title: Bila sam jača
programme.desc: "Bila sam jača" je jugoslovenski film iz 1953. godine u režiji Gustava Gavrina, koji je pisao i scenario u saradnji sa Radošem Novakovićem. Za vreme racije okupatora, partizanka _ lekar rešava da umesto bekstva sa lekovima na slobodnu teritoriju, pomogne bolesnom detetu okupatrovog saradnika. Dete biva spaseno, a njena lekarska etika pobeđuje.

programme.title: Area Q.
programme.desc: Thomas Mathews, an investigative journalist whose world is turned upside-down when his son disappears, is sent to Brazil to investigate close encounter sightings.

programme.title: El camino
programme.desc: Elliot, 31, a product of the Washington D.C. foster care system, has spent most of his life moving from place to place. When he is contacted by Matthew, a childhood friend from "the system" dying of cancer, Elliot goes to be by his side. At the funeral, he meets Gray and Lily, two friends of Matthew, both aimless in their present lives. Motivated by their sense of loss, and personal anger, Gray, Lily and Elliot steal Matthew's ashes and take them to Mexico. As the three travelers journey cross-country with Matthew's urn in tow, they are forced to confront their own sense of family, identity and future. Set against the changing American landscape, EL CAMINO follows these characters as they search for themselves in a country that has lost it's own identity. Gray, the wayward son of a prominent D.C. family, has left his pregnant girlfriend. He is angry, volatile and fearful of commitment. Lily is Matthew's ex-girlfriend. Unbeknownst to her parents, she has dropped out of college and become an exotic dancer. Lost in alcohol and pills she longs for her mother's approval. Elliot is outside the cultural mainstream. He carries a suitcase filled with documents and mementos of his life. An explorer of human experience, he interviews and videotapes people he meets. Haunted by dreams of his mother's drowning, Elliot struggles to find his place in the world. EL CAMINO is a humorous and compassionate film about friendship, family, and search for self in today's American landscape

programme.title: Running for Grace
programme.desc: A timeless story set in Hawaii in 1920s, about a young man who transcends the boundaries of race and class in search of forbidden love.

programme.title: Unexpected
programme.desc: Bob and Amy are at a crossroads: she wants to adopt a child, he doesn't. Will renovating their house and rescuing animals solve their problems? Will their new handyman and his son's pregnant girlfriend be the miracle they're looking for?...

programme.title: Riff Raff
programme.desc: Vincent is an ex-criminal who more than anything, just wants a normal, peaceful life. He and his wife Sandy, have built a loving family with their son DJ and are spending their last summer in a cabin before he goes off to college. Chaos ensues when Vincent's disowned son Rocco, his girlfriend Marina, and Vincent's ex-wife Ruth abruptly show up to spoil the festivities with an ominous warning: famed gangsters Leftie and Lonnie are coming for them.

programme.title: She's No Angel
programme.desc: A pregnant woman fleeing a violent boyfriend, boards a train and is taken into care by a newlywed couple. The train crashes, the couple are killed and the girl is taken for the dead newlywed wife because she was wearing her ring at the time the crash happened.

programme.title: Spirit
programme.desc: A recently bereved father takes his daughter to a new town only to find that their new Victorian house appears to be haunted.

programme.title: Raspberry Magic
programme.desc: "Raspberry Magic" is a coming-of-age story about 11-year-old Monica Shah, who thinks she must win the science fair in order to bring her father back after he runs out on the family. She blames herself for her parents' problems, and takes charge when her mother falls into a deep depression. Set behind the backdrop of a beautiful forest, Monica's experiment uses touch therapy to help raspberries grow faster. She asks, is it nature or nurture that can truly help a being grow? Does it even matter? Through her ups and downs with her family, she learns that it's a complex question, and the answer isn't so simple.

programme.title: Lost on a Mountain in Maine
No Limit Kids
programme.desc: Ashton, Celeste, and Becca are three unlikely middle school outcasts who form a club in an abandoned theater. There, they meet Charlie (Bill Cobbs, Night at the Museum), a homeless man who shares their passion for musical theater. When the theater is scheduled to be torn down, the teenagers set out to save the landmark with a modern-day performance of Shakespeare's Much Ado About Nothing. Along the way, the group learns to treat others with respect and stand up for their beliefs. This Dove-approved film also features Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Lee Meriwether.

programme.title: Time Out of Mind
programme.desc: Oren Moverman's drama Time out of Mind stars Richard Gere as George, a homeless, mentally-ill man who has been unable to hold a job for years. He drifts through the city looking for food, alcohol, and shelter. He also tries to make contact with his estranged daughter (Jena Malone). Eventually George takes advantage of some of the social services provided by the city of New York, but he lacks the proper paperwork to get the financial assistance he needs. He befriends a fellow homeless man (Ben Vereen) who claims to have been a successful jazz musician. Time Out of Mind screened at the 2014 Toronto International Film Festival.

programme.title: The Cooler
programme.desc: In an old school Las Vegas casino, its top gambling jinx breaks his curse when he falls in love, much to his boss' consternation.

programme.title: London boulevard
programme.desc: Priča o londonskom kriminalcu koji izlazi iz zatvora i započinje vezu s mladom povučenom glumicom.

programme.title: Dobar komšija
programme.desc: Dvojica nestašnih srednjoškolaca uspešno uveravaju svog vremešnog komšiju da u njegovoj kući ima duhova. Međutim, niz nesrećnih okolnosti pretvara njihovu bezazlenu šalu u tragediju.

programme.title: Devojka broj jedan
programme.desc: Producent, režiser i akciona zvezda; to je sve što vam je potrebno da snimite najbolji film svih vremena. Zar ne?

programme.title: Pad Kandahara
programme.desc: 1999 godina, britanski miner koji radi za Talibane u Avganistanu, mora da beži, kad je uvučen u smrtonosnu igru, zaveru i izdaju.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Vidimo se u septembru
programme.desc: "Vidimo se u septembru" je originalna romantična komedija, smeštena u moderni Menhetn. Film govori o Lizi, prelepoj ženi koja naizgled ima sve, ali se duboko u sebi plaši vezivanja. Kad sazna da će njen terapeut celog avgusta biti na odmoru, šokirana je i uplašena. Umesto da ovu vest prihvati smireno, ona traži pomoć od ogorčene prijateljice, Monike.

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Kamp snova
programme.desc: Devojka koja nema mnogo dodirnih tačaka sa sportom, Vitni Karmajkl, prijavljuje se u fizički veoma zahtevan letnji kamp kako bi unela promene u svoj život, ali se tamo zaljubljuje u svog trenera. Na svom putovanju pronalazi snagu da prihvati sebe onakvu kakva jeste i da se oslobodi tuđih očekivanja.

programme.title: Zen noar
programme.desc: Neimenovani "noir" detektiv, koji još uvek oplakuje gubitak svoje supruge, istražuje tajanstvenu smrt u budističkom hramu, ali su njegove veštine i logički pristup rešavanju zločina potpuno beskorisni u intuitivnom, nelinearnom svetu žena.

programme.title: Raskinuli smo
programme.desc: Dugogodišnji partneri Lori i Dag raskidaju samo nekoliko dana pre venčanja Lorine mlađe sestre Bi i Džejsona. Da ne bi pokvarili slavlje, odlučuju da se pretvaraju da su i dalje zajedno dok vikend ne prođe.

programme.title: Priča o Džejn Ostin
programme.desc: Biografski portret mlade Džejn Ostin pre slave i romanse s mladim Ircem.

programme.title: Poslednja potera
programme.desc: Godine 1909, Vili Boj i njegova voljena Karlota beže nakon što on u kobnom sukobu slučajno usmrti njenog oca. Dok se predsednik Taft sprema da poseti ovu oblast, lokalni šerif i dvojica indijanskih tragača kreću u poteru za čovekom kog smatraju ubicom svog plemenskog vođe.

programme.title: Poslednja stvar
programme.desc: Dilan Derindžer, usamljeni stomatolog sa Floride, suočava se s osobom iz prošlosti koja mu donosi vesti koje ga vode na uzbudljivo putovanje. Na ovom putovanju otkriće sebe i promeniti sopstveni život.

programme.title: Draga Elizabet
programme.desc: Muškarac koji vodi dosadan život slučajno počinje da proganja staru koleginicu s fakulteta, glumicu Elizabet Benks, na društvenim mrežama. U svojim pokušajima da dokaže da je poznaje, ponovo otkriva sebe i pravo značenje prijateljstva.

programme.title: Nikad neću biti tvoja
programme.desc: Majka započinje vezu s mlađim muškarcem, dok se njena ćerka prvi put zaljubljuje. Ipak, sudbina će tu umešati prste i poigrati se njihovim životima.

programme.title: Poslednji dah
programme.desc: Grupa starih prijatelja sa fakulteta ponovo se okuplja na ronilačkom izletu u Karibima, istražujući olupinu ratnog broda iz Drugog svetskog rata. Međutim, ubrzo će biti zarobljeni u podvodnom lavirintu od zarđalog metala, okruženi velikim belim ajkulama.

programme.title: Ona je kriminalac
programme.desc: Sju Parker gurnuta je u očajničku borbu da spase porodični posao koji se, zbog nemara njenog oca, nalazi na ivici propasti. Dolaskom šarmantnog skitnice, ona prepoznaje jedinu nadu da spreči da njihov bar padne u ruke nemilosrdnog lokalnog tajkuna.

programme.title: Ona je kriminalac
programme.desc: Sju Parker gurnuta je u očajničku borbu da spase porodični posao koji se, zbog nemara njenog oca, nalazi na ivici propasti. Dolaskom šarmantnog skitnice, ona prepoznaje jedinu nadu da spreči da njihov bar padne u ruke nemilosrdnog lokalnog tajkuna.

programme.title: Gospođica niko i ništa
programme.desc: Sarah Jane je nesrećna u ljubavi, živi sa svojom ekscentričnom majkom i radi u firmi Judge Pharmaceuticals kao sekretarica bez ikakve perspektive za unapredjenje. Iznenadno unapredjenje na menadžersko mesto _ izgleda je to šta je tražila. Ipak zajedno s unapredjenjem pojavljuje se novi svet, pun konkurencije od strane drugih poslovodja,koji je pun spletaka i mnogo komplikovan. Sara počinje da eliminiše konkurenciju na jedini način koji zna … ubija. Na putu ka vrhu upoznaje iznenada muškarca svojih snova _ detektiva Billa Malloya, koji namerava da otkrije tajne smrti u Judge Pharmaceuticals.

programme.title: Rat u kartelu
programme.desc: Tajni agenti, kršeći zakon, razradjuju najveći narko kartel u Americi. Labave veze s bivšim šefom meksičkog narko kartela, dovode ih do tajni sveta droge. Sve se komplikuje kad elitna jedinica policije _ Divizija 123 _ počinje da otkriva sledeće nivoe narko kartela _ da bi na kraju ga preuzela. To je istinska studija ljudskih dilema _ policajci i izazovi koji stoje pred njima. Briga za najbliže, pružanje zaštite i _ u isto vreme _ posvećenost poslu. Sjaj života u Gradu Andjela i odmah posle toga uvidjaj u njegove najmračnije ćoškove. "DISRUP/DISMANTLE" pokazuje policajce koji bore se protiv ljudi bez skrupula, koji ih ipak na neki način privlače. Izgleda na prvi pogled kao tipična šema _ policajci kontra kriminalci _ ta priča je ispričana s neverovatnom svežinom, koncentrisana na život odličnih policajca koji moraju da biraju i koji prave greške. Kad pronalaze tela jednog iz kompanijona _ to baca loše svetlo na istragu. Tada Divizija 123 ne osvrćući se na zakon konačno rešava slučaj.

programme.title: Aleks iz Venisa
programme.desc: Advokatica opsednuta poslom primorana je da iz temelja promeni svoj život nakon što je suprug iznenada napusti.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i prodavnica rezanaca
programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Tačnije, to on misli, jer poremećeni Žang ima sopstveni plan. Uslediće još veća erupcija krvi, prevara i nasilja.

programme.title: Srećni zmaj
programme.desc: Mladi kineski zmaj, pošto je bio nevaljao, kažnjen je i bogovi ga šalju na zemlju kao običnog smrtnika. Mora da prođe kroz čudnu zemlju pre nego što zle sile ne shvate ko je on. Zaroni u svet fantazije, prateći nestašnog zmaja koji je magično pretvoren u malog dečaka koji je izbačen iz svoje kuće i mora da živi s ljudima. Kad snage dobra i zla saznaju za njega, rade sve da ga nađu pošto jedino on može da pronađe magični mač. Taj ko ga ima može da vlada celim svemirom. Da li će da pronađe mač pre nego što ode u pogrešne ruke? Da li opet postane mali zmaj?

programme.title: Mrvica i rudnik zlata
programme.desc: Nakon ponovnog ujedinjenja s porodicom, Mrvica se teško navikava na luksuzan život. Kada ga otme stari neprijatelj, mora upotrebiti najbolje stečeno znanje iz novog i starog života, kako bi pobegao i spasao svoje roditelje.

programme.title: Nesavesno lečenje
programme.desc: On je hirurg koji se više ne bavi medicinom zbog napada panike, nakon operacije koja je loše završena. Njegova supruga je advokat za lekarske greške i počinje da radi na slučaju žene koja je bila medicinska sestra njenog supruga.

programme.title: Vampirice
programme.desc: Dve vampirice u današnjem Njujorku suočavaju se sa zastrašujućim ljubavnim mogućnostima.

programme.title: Istina o lažima
programme.desc: Gilbi se zatiče u zamršenoj mreži laži, jer je istinu preteško priznati, a još teže prihvatiti.

programme.title: Čovek od poverenja
programme.desc: Priča o Beriju Monkovu, mladom harizmatičnom biznismenu koji postaje imućni direktor i stiže do samog vrha uz pomoć laži, prevara i krađe.

programme.title: Uhvati me za ruku
programme.desc: Majka troje dece, koja živi u Londonu i nalazi se na vrhuncu karijere, saznaje da boluje od multiple skleroze. Nakon iznenadne smrti supruga i gubitka posla, vraća se u rodnu Australiju, gde slučajan susret sa srednjoškolskom ljubavi budi novu nadu u ljubav dok vodi tešku borbu sa bolešću.

programme.title: Ubojita magija
programme.desc: Na turneji po Britaniji 1926. godine, Hari Hudini započinje strastvenu vezu sa vidovnjakinjom koja namerava da prevari sjajnog mađioničara.

programme.title: Ukradena dolina
programme.desc: Da bi spasila život svojoj majci, meksičko-navaho mehaničarka udružuje snage s odmetnicom kako bi se suprotstavile korumpiranom zemljoposedniku.

programme.title: Trbosek: Neispričana priča
programme.desc: Detektiv i patolog se udružuju kako bi rešili niz strašnih ubistava u viktorijanskom Londonu _ ali jedan od njih krije smrtonosnu tajnu.

programme.title: Biografija zločinca
programme.desc: Nakon što So Do-jong izađe iz zatvora, Han Dong-su i Han Dže-bom kuju plan da razotkriju njegovo kriminalno carstvo, dok se istovremeno bore sa sopstvenom savešću.

programme.title: Biografija zločinca
programme.desc: Han Dong-su priprema odbranu svoje supruge Hje-jong, ali situacija dobija neočekivan obrt kada So Do-jong ponudi pomoć.

programme.title: The Passionate Plumber
programme.desc: Paris plumber Elmer Tuttle is enlisted by socialite Patricia Alden to help make her lover Tony Lagorce jealous. With the help of his friend Julius J. McCracken and through the high society contacts he has made through Patricia, Elmer hopes to find financing for his latest invention, a pistol with a range-finding light. Comic complications ensue when Elmer's effort to interest a military leader is misconstrued as an assassination attempt.

programme.title: The Mysterious Mr. Wong
programme.desc: Mr. Wong is a "harmless" Chinatown shopkeeper by day and relentless blood-thirsty pursuer of the Twelve Coins of Confucius by night. With possession of the coins, Mr. Wong will be supreme ruler of the Chinese province of Keelat, and his evil destiny will be fulfilled. A killing spree follows in dark and dangerous Chinatown as Wong gets control of 11 of the 12 coins. Reporter Jason Barton and his girl Peg are hot on his trail, but soon find themselves in serious trouble when they stumble onto Wong's headquarters.

programme.title: The Phantom of 42nd Street
programme.desc: A theatre critic (Dave O'Brien) teams up with a cop (Jack Mulhall) to investigate the murder of a Broadway actor.

programme.title: Doctor Blood's Coffin
programme.desc: Greta is a beautiful young woman abused by her brother Franz and left to die in childbirth by her illicit lover, the aristocrat Dr. von Ravensbrück. Bereft with grief, Franz reanimates his dead sister using a formula engraved on an ancient Incan medallion. Greta then returns as an undead avenging angel, reaping revenge on the Ravensbrück family and her manically possessive brother.

programme.title: Please Murder Me
programme.desc: A lawyer tries to exact justice on a woman he defended in court -- a woman whom he found out was guilty after getting her off.

programme.title: Indiscreet
programme.desc: A young woman jeopardizes the relationship with the man she loves when a no-account from her past shows up.

programme.title: Scarlet Street
programme.desc: A banned box-office hit, Scarlet Street is one of Fritz Lang's greatest American films. Middle-aged cashier Chris Cross rescues streetwise Kitty and tumbles into a spiral of desire, deception, and revenge. As his obsession grows, Chris is seduced, degraded, and transformed, while fate delivers a grimly ironic justice. Featuring standout performances by Joan Bennett and Dan Duryea, the film is packed with sharp twists and masterful direction—a classic, pitch-dark gem of film noir.

programme.title: Behave Yourself
programme.desc: When a cute Welsh terrier follows Bill Denny home, little does he know that all gangland has its eye on that dog.

programme.title: Following Nazarin
programme.desc: A journey through memory accompanied by Buñuel's photographs taken during the scouting of locations for "Nazarín", as well as the ones made by Manuel Álvarez Bravo during the shooting of the film, along with the testimonies and reflections of artists, filmmakers and intellectuals like Luis Eduardo Aute, Jean Claude Carrière, Carlos Reygadas, Silvia Pinal, Arturo Ripsetein or Carlos Saura among many others, to re-discover the poetic, vivid and inspiring force of Buñuel's cinematography.

programme.title: The Lady Refuses
programme.desc: A wealthy London nobleman hires a pretty but poor young woman to distract his playboy son from marrying a golddigger. Complications ensue when the girl and the father begin to fall for each other, and things get even more complicated when the son declares his love for her, too.

programme.title: When a Dream Comes True
programme.desc: Ed decides to leave his life in Barcelona to take a trip to the United States to follow his childhood dream of becoming a filmmaker there. Close to turning 40, and with his wedding just around the corner, he realizes that his life has not worked out as he had planned. An identity crisis begins which makes him leave everything and try to make his childhood dream —the American dream— come true. With the script of a film he wrote a few years ago under his arm, and the idea of trying to make the project a reality in the United States, Ed embarks on a road trip from New York to Hollywood, on which he meets diverse characters with whom he reflects upon the pros and cons of following our dreams, while at the same time he tries to achieve his and seeks a more precise definition of happiness.

programme.title: The Monster Maker
programme.desc: Mad scientist injects his enemies with acromegaly virus, causing them to become hideously deformed.

programme.title: Africa Screams
programme.desc: When bookseller Buzz cons Diana into thinking that his friend Stanley knows all there is to know about Africa, they are abducted and ordered to lead Diana and her henchmen to an African tribe in search of a fortune in jewels.

programme.title: Renegade Girl
programme.desc: Ann Shelby, whose family is allied with the notorious William Quantrill, turns outlaw to revenge herself on a renegade Indian who killed her brother.

programme.title: Pot o' Gold
programme.desc: Jimmy goes to work with his uncle, the owner of a food factory. Before he gets there, he befriends an Irish family who happens to be his uncle's worst enemy because of their love for music and in-house band who constantly practices.

programme.title: King of the Zombies
programme.desc: During World War II, a small plane somewhere over the Caribbean runs low on fuel and is blown off course by a storm. Guided by a faint radio signal, they crash-land on an island. The passenger, his manservant and the pilot take refuge in a mansion owned by a doctor. The quick-witted yet easily-frightened manservant soon becomes convinced the mansion is haunted by zombies and ghosts.

programme.title: College
programme.desc: Ronald's high-school valedictory address praises books and condemns sports. His girlfriend Mary condemns his attitude. Fearing to lose her to rival Jeff, he decides to go to college and pay more attentions to sports.

programme.title: Doll Face
programme.desc: Burlesque queen Doll Face Carroll is dismissed from an audition for a legitimate Broadway show because she lacks culture. Her boss/manager Mike decides that she can get both culture and plenty of publicity by writing her autobiography. He hires a ghost writer to do all the work, but doesn't count on the possibility that Doll Face and her collaborator might have more than a book on their minds.

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: Secret Service agents make a deal with a counterfeiting inmate to be released on early parole if he will help them recover some bogus moneymaking plates, but he plans to double cross them.

programme.title: The Smallest Show on Earth
programme.desc: Jean and Bill are a married couple trying to scrape a living. Out of the blue they receive a telegram informing them Bill's long-lost uncle has died and left them his business—a cinema in the town of Sloughborough. Unfortunately they can't sell it for the fortune they hoped as they discover it is falling down and almost worthless.

programme.title: The Smallest Show on Earth
programme.desc: Jean and Bill are a married couple trying to scrape a living. Out of the blue they receive a telegram informing them Bill's long-lost uncle has died and left them his business—a cinema in the town of Sloughborough. Unfortunately they can't sell it for the fortune they hoped as they discover it is falling down and almost worthless.

programme.title: The Fatal Hour
programme.desc: When a police officer is murdered, Captain Street looks to Mr. Wong to catch the killer. Prime Suspect: Frank Belden Jr., whose father is a businessman well known for both his success and dishonesty. Mr. Wong faces increasing danger and is nearly executed himself as the investigation develops in treachery and complexity. As Mr. Wong follows the trail of dead bodies, he uncovers a jewel smuggling ring on the San Francisco waterfront and a case much larger than the death of a police officer.

programme.title: Soldier Jane
programme.desc: Fanni has had enough of money and Anna has had enough of pigs. Fanni leaves the city and her pearls behind, while Anna is stuck wearing muddy overalls. When they finally cross paths, they embark on a punk adventure towards Marxist liberty.

programme.title: Fear and Desire
programme.desc: After their airplane crashes behind enemy lines, four soldiers must survive and try to find a way back to their battalion. However, when they come across a local peasant girl the horrors of war quickly become apparent.

programme.title: Mr Wong - Doomed to Die
programme.desc: Shipping magnate Cyrus Wentworth, downcast over a disaster to his ocean liner "Wentworth Castle" (carrying, oddly enough, an illicit shipment of Chinese bonds) is shot in his office at the very moment of kicking out his daughter's fiance Dick Fleming. Of course, Captain Street arrests Dick, but reporter Bobbie Logan, the attractive thorn in Street's side, is so convinced he's wrong that she enlists the help of detective James Lee Wong to find the real killer.

programme.title: Indian
programme.desc: Dreaming about the Wild West in the 1970s in Eastern Europe is not enough…

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln
programme.desc: A biopic dramatizing Abraham Lincoln's life through a series of vignettes depicting its defining chapters: his romance with Ann Rutledge; his early years as a country lawyer; his marriage to Mary Todd; his debates with Stephen A. Douglas; the election of 1860; his presidency during the Civil War; and his assassination in Ford's Theater in 1865.

programme.title: The Tall T
programme.desc: An independent former ranch foreman is kidnapped along with an heiress, who is being held for ransom by trio of ruthless outlaws.

programme.title: My Dear Secretary
programme.desc: A budding young writer thinks it's her lucky day when she is chosen to be the new secretary for Owen Waterbury, famous novelist. She is soon disppointed, however, when he turns out to be an erratic, immature playboy. Opposites attract, of course, but not without sub-plots that touch on competitiveness within marriage and responsibility.

programme.title: Nancy Drew... Reporter
programme.desc: While participating in a contest at a local newspaper in which school children are asked to submit a news story, local attorney Carson Drew's daughter Nancy intercepts a real story assignment. She "covers" the inquest of the death of a woman who was poisoned. Nancy doesn't think the young woman accused of the crime is guilty and corrals her neighbor Ted into searching for a vital piece of evidence and stumbles onto the identity of the real killer.

programme.title: The Murder in the Museum
programme.desc: When a city councilman is murdered while investigating allegations of drug dealing going on a a somewhat disreputable sideshow, the daughter of the chief suspect teams up with a newspaper reporter to find the real killer.

programme.title: Go for Broke!
programme.desc: The story of Japanese-American soldiers who fought in Europe during World War II.

programme.title: The Plague at the Karatas Village
programme.desc: A new mayor comes to the remote village Karatas. A very strange illness reins over here. However somebody is used to live with it and says this is a simple flu.

programme.title: Lady of Burlesque
programme.desc: After one member of their group is murdered, the performers at a burlesque house must work together to find out who the killer is before they strike again.

programme.title: Christmas Wish
programme.desc: A little squirrel with lots of charm accidentally helps two poor, down-but-NOT-out families overcome their obstacles.

programme.title: Private Buckaroo
programme.desc: A rebellious young inductee has trouble toeing the line until he meets a retired officer's lovely daughter. James and his band are also drafted and decide to perk up their camp by putting on a big show.

programme.title: Delightfully Dangerous
programme.desc: Young Sherry Williams dreams of having a singing career, and she idolizes her older sister Josephine, who has gone to New York to perform on the stage. When Sherry is distraught just before performing at her school, a visiting Broadway producer encourages her by telling her positive things about her sister. Soon afterwards, Sherry decides to make a surprise trip to New York to visit Josephine _ but what she finds there is not at all what she expected.

programme.title: A Farewell to Arms
programme.desc: A ravishing adaptation of Ernest Hemingway's legendary novel, A FAREWELL TO ARMS stars Gary Cooper as Lt. Frederic Henry, a young ambulance driver for the Italian army in WWI, more interested in chasing women than the enemy. When seeking cover during an air raid, he encounters Nurse Catherine Barkley, and the world shifts under his feet. They fall in love, but the war keeps wrenching them apart. These painful separations force Frederic to choose between love and battle, a decision that tests him morally and spiritually, and leads to one of the most rapturously romantic endings of all time.

programme.title: The Fabulous Dorseys
programme.desc: The rise and rise of the Fabulous Dorsey brothers is charted in this whimsical step down memory lane, Tommy and Jimmy Dorsey play themselves in this vehicle for their excellent music.

programme.title: Girl Gang
programme.desc: A sleazy gangster has a gang of young girls commit robberies and prostitution for him by getting them hooked on drugs.

programme.title: Klinika za kožne probleme
programme.desc: Kerolajn pati od prekomernog rasta dlačica po celom licu, a čudne kvržice na Entonijevim testisima sprečavaju ga da ima vezu.

programme.title: Klinika za kožne probleme
programme.desc: Dr Ema pomaže Oldrinu, ocu koji je u stalnim bolovima. Osim toga, Pegin veliki lipom narušio je njeno samopouzdanje.

programme.title: Klinika za kožne probleme
programme.desc: Starla ima veliku izraslinu na stomaku koja joj izaziva bol, a trogodišnji Klej ima užasnu gljivičnu infekciju po svim prstima.

programme.title: Ljudsko telo: Neobične priče
programme.desc: Emisija govori o ljudima iz celog sveta koji pate od retkih i misterioznih medicinskih stanja. Nekima su potrebne toliko složene operacije da su šanse za preživljavanje minimalne.

programme.title: Opasne telesne povrede
programme.desc: Upoznajte pet ljudi koji u svom organizmu imaju pet neobjašnjivih predmeta, a među njima je i mlada devojka koja je progutala nešto što joj kida utrobu.

programme.title: Venčanica iz snova: Beneluks
programme.desc: Pratite holandske i flamanske neveste u potrazi za savršenom venčanicom. Američki guru za venčanice Rendi Fenoli će im pomoći u u tom procesu.

programme.title: Kompulzivno gomilanje: Živi zatrpani
programme.desc: Više od dve decenije Majklovo kompulsivno sakupljanje je razdiralo njegovu porodicu. Sad ima još šest nedelja da ispoštuje pravila protivpožarne zaštite ili rizikuje da sve izgubi.

programme.title: Kompulzivno gomilanje: Živi zatrpani
programme.desc: Džojsine sakupljačke navike razdiru njenu porodicu i prete njenom braku. A Norinino sakupljanje je posledica teškog razvoda. Da li ove žene mogu da preokrenu situaciju?

programme.title: Neverovatan ja
programme.desc: Ohrabrujuće i inspirativne priče jedinstvenih pojedinaca širom sveta koji žive sa retkim zdravstvenim problemima i koji su rešeni da žive svoje najbolje živote.

programme.title: Neverovatan ja
programme.desc: Ohrabrujuće i inspirativne priče jedinstvenih pojedinaca širom sveta koji žive sa retkim zdravstvenim problemima i koji su rešili da žive najbolje što mogu.

programme.title: Kim Kardašijan: Krađa dijamanata
programme.desc: Kim Kardašijan je opljačkana uz pretnju oružjem _ ukraden je nakit vredan 6 miliona dolara, a za parisku elitnu brigadu ugled grada je u pitanju.

programme.title: Mali samci
programme.desc: Čvrsto povezana grupa prijatelja iz zajednice malih ljudi okuplja se za jedno nezaboravno leto, ispunjeno smehom, ljubavlju i rastom.

programme.title: Džej i Pamela
programme.desc: Džej i Pamela drže govor o seksu i invaliditetu na konferenciji. Pamela deli svoju trnovitu istoriju veza, a problemi sa poverenjem je savladavaju.

programme.title: Uređivanje kuća: Australija
programme.desc: Džordžija i Riči oživljavaju voljenu porodičnu kuću za dugo očekivano preuređenje kuhinje i kupatila.

programme.title: Devedeset dana: Samački život
programme.desc: Nakon što su im se međunarodne veze raspale, šestoro miljenika publike je slobodno. Hoće li njihov povratak na scenu zabavljanja biti uspešan?

programme.title: Devedeset dana: Samački život
programme.desc: Pratite avanture grupe ljudi iz serije čiji su se međusobni odnosi raspali i koji se sada upuštaju u novu avanturu i počinju izlaziti na sastanke u potrazi za novim ljubavima. Neki od miljenika publike ponovo pokušavaju da pronađu srodnu dušu, a vi im se možete pridružiti na tom putovanju!

programme.title: Moj prelep život sa viškom kilograma
programme.desc: Ovaj rijaliti program prati život žene po imenu Vitni, čija je velika strast ples. Ali, ona se ugojila preko 100 kilograma, što joj stvara velike probleme, ne samo u plesu već i u svakodnevnom životu.

programme.title: Moj prelep život sa viškom kilograma
programme.desc: Vitni se brine da ju je Badi možda napustio zbog svoje nove devojke i priznaje da je započela onlajn vezu sa misterioznim muškarcem iz Pariza.

programme.title: Neverstvo
programme.desc: Kako prezreni ljubavnik reaguje kad se ispostavi da je njegov partner izdajnik? Ova serija rekonstruiše izdaje, tajne i laži koje dovode parove do tačke pucanja.

programme.title: Klinika za lečenje gojaznosti u Italiji
programme.desc: Visoko specijalizovana klinika u Napulju pomaže nekolicini morbidno gojaznih ljudi dok pokušavaju da smanje svoju težinu i uđu u najtežu godinu svog života.

programme.title: 90 dana: Poslednje utočište
programme.desc: Parovi serijala "90 dana" na ivici razvoda odlaze u rajsko odmaralište da spasu svoje veze. Da li će im ovo utočište sa intenzivnom terapijom pomoći da se vrate na pravi put?

programme.title: Rubijales protiv Ermosove: Poljubac sa Svetskog prvenstva
programme.desc: Pratite bivšeg šefa španskog fudbalskog saveza Luisa Rubijalesa tokom suđenja zbog kontraverznog poljupca na Svetskom prvenstvu za žene.

programme.title: Klinika za kožne probleme
programme.desc: Kejtini ogromni čirevi na nogama ostavili su je u nepodnošljivom bolu, dok Mija ima velike izrasline koje rastu na levom uhu nakon što joj se jedan od pirsinga inficirao.

programme.title: Klinika za kožne probleme
programme.desc: Šeron je odložila venčanje zbog velikog lipoma na desnom ramenu, a Džordžija traži pomoć za svoj teški slučaj palmoplantarne pustuloze.

programme.title: Klinika za kožne probleme
programme.desc: Dželani ima stanje kože koje mu je ostavilo bolne kvržice i ružne ožiljke. Monik je u potrazi za tretmanom za čudne kvržice na vrhu nosa.

programme.title: Klinika za kožne probleme
programme.desc: Mišel ima bolest zbog koje joj se celo lice upalilo. Ali je izgubila samopouzdanje zbog crvenih fleka koje su joj prekrile celo telo.

programme.title: Ljudsko telo: Neobične priče

programme.title: Venčanica iz snova: Beneluks
programme.desc: Pratite holandske i flamanske neveste u potrazi za savršenom venčanicom. Američki guru za venčanice Rendi Fenoli će im pomoći u u tom procesu.

programme.title: Neverstvo
programme.desc: Poznati hirurg Paolo i njegova supruga Livija nemaju dece i zbog toga su pod pritiskom. Kada on potraži utehu u drugoj ženi, Livija mu se javno sveti.

programme.title: Devedeset dana: Samački život
programme.desc: Nakon što su se njihove međunarodne veze raspale, šest miljenika gledalaca je slobodno i spremno za romansu. Da li će njihov povratak na scenu zabavljanja biti uspešan?

programme.title: Veridba od 90 dana: Period upoznavanja
programme.desc: Rijaliti u kom gledaoci mogu da prate razvoj ljubavne priče parova koji su odlučili da javno eksponiraju svoju vezu.

programme.title: Najbolji prijatelji od 500 kg
programme.desc: Na Fit farmi, Ešli uči kako da izađe iz svoje zone komfora. Vanesa shvata da je sposobna za više nego što je mislila, a Tina se konačno trgla.

programme.title: Živeti sa 300 kg
programme.desc: Pratimo živote 12 ljudi, od kojih je svako težak oko 300 kg. Tokom svog jednogodišnjeg putovanja oni pokušavaju da izgube, svi zajedno, stotine kilograma, da bi ostali u životu.

programme.title: Sve žene mog muža: Retrospektiva
programme.desc: Na putovanju širom zemlje kako bi preselili Dženel u Severnu Karolinu, Kristin, Dženel i Dejvid se zaustavljaju u baru gde Dženel ima prvu priliku.

programme.title: Izdaja
programme.desc: Dona Boklet, koja je ceo život provela na Long Ajlendu, objavljuje da se seli na Floridu. Njeni prijatelji i porodica šokirani su tom vešću, a preseljenje se završava ubistvom.

programme.title: Izdaja
programme.desc: Dva puta razvedena majka dvoje dece Keti Gobl je konačno sebe stavila na prvo mesto. Ali, njen novi stil života dovodi do brutalne i smrtonosne izdaje.

programme.title: Sestre od 500 kilograma
programme.desc: Temi i Ejmi se raspravljaju oko noćnog izlaska. Kris i Ejmi posećuju geneologa, a rezultati navode porodicu da razmisli o putovanju u inostranstvo.

programme.title: Sestre od 500 kilograma
programme.desc: Svi se pripremaju za London usred još jednog sukoba između Tami i Amande. Kris i Tami se nadaju da će dobiti odobrenje za operaciju uklanjanja kože.

programme.title: Živeti sa 300 kg
programme.desc: Emisija prati živote ljudi od kojih je svako težak oko 300 kg. Kroz njihovo godinu dana dugo putovanje, oni pokušavaju da svi zajedno izgube stotine kilograma da bi preživeli.

programme.title: Devedeset dana za venčanje
programme.desc: Koristeći jedinstvenu vizu, parovi kreću na 90-dnevno putovanje. Njihovi prijatelji iz inostranstva će otputovati u SAD i imaće 90 dana da se venčaju ili napuste zemlju.

programme.title: Toksično
programme.desc: Elizabet Čembers otkriva toksični brak Kejt Ranta i kako njen muž, vojnik, koristi svoju službu da se izvuče.

programme.title: Stopala me ubijaju
programme.desc: Posvećeni muž se nada da će mu dr Sara pomoći sa gljivicama na stopalima i spasiti mu brak, a žena sa prepletenim nožnim prstima i niskim samopoštovanjem traži pomoć dr Ebonija.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ _ experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: An international team kayaks the classic runs of New Zealand's south island and in turn they find a new adventure around every bend.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Trolling for Chinook Salmon in Prince Rupert then making big run Southbound to Hartley Bay through Grenville Channel!

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: A dominant male spirit attacks Mark, who then turns on Sherry. Amelia flees in terror during her lone vigil.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As Loro Parque's head vet, Jorge never knows from one day to the next what will come through his clinic. From tending to oversexed otters, fine-footed flamingoes or armoured armadillos, a day spent with Jorge, is a day immersed in nature from the four corners of the globe. Ever seen a grown man hug a turtle? For Javier, Loro Parque's Head of Environmental Affairs, it's all part of the job! He's hitting the high seas of Tenerife with a turtle tracker in hand to help with scientific research _ but first he's just got to locate the turtle _ 2,000 meters down in the ocean!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: "Finding Nemo" may have brought fame to the striped clownfish but their newfound popularity has sent worldwide numbers into decline. Now we follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more Nemos to come. Jorge has got a 200-pound problem on his hands. Lin Mao the white tiger has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis. Problem is, Lin Mao's not responding to the anesthetic Jorge just administered and he has to decide what to do next...very quickly.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The legendary wild dingo, the iconic kangaroos, vicious feral cats, the delightfully bizarre platypus and the unmistakably cuddly koala _ all call Australia home. Koala _ Hidden high in gum trees, the koala is one of Australia's most beloved animals. Dingo _ Sleek, agile, and descended from wolves, dingoes are Australia's top land carnivores. Kangaroo _ With powerful legs and iconic bounds, kangaroos embody the spirit of Australia. Wild Cats _ Over 12 million wild house cats roam Australia's diverse landscapes. Platypus _ Unique and mysterious, the platypus is one of Australia's most enchanting creatures.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Radar accurate eyes survey the land, slotted feathers adjust flight paths as falcons attack, pelicans soar, kestrels hover, owls silently fly, parrots flock, vultures swarm and eagles swoop. Which is the true Master of the Sky? Peregrine Falcon _ Revered for speed and power, this raptor was favored by ancient falconers. Budgie _ Bright green and yellow budgies light up Australia's skies in lively flocks. Wedge-tailed Eagle _ Australia's largest bird of prey commands awe with its soaring presence. Pelican _ Graceful giants of the sky, pelicans glide in formation on rising thermals. Seabirds _ Nearly 300 species live between sea and air, truly free in their vast domain. Barn Owl _ Mysterious and wise, the barn owl watches silently from the shadows. Vulture _ Africa's plains are scanned by vultures, nature's cleanup crew. Nankeen Kestrel _ Australia's smallest falcon, elegant and inquisitive, glides over open land.

programme.title: The Blue Realm
programme.desc: The tiny island nation of Tonga in the remote South Pacific is a haven for the magnificent mammals. With few natural resources or other means of income, the country is considering opening it's waters to foreign whaling fleets in exchange for hard currency. The merits and legitimacy of scientific whaling by Japan and other nations is hotly debated. The iconic species is a favorite of whale watchers from Alaska to Mexico and the stage is set for an epic battle between whalers and conservationists. Humpbacks: From Tonga to Antarctica also features Paul Watson of the Sea Shepherd Society.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: The ocean is a harsh world where survival depends on feeding and avoiding predators. Sea creatures use camouflage, bright colors, venom, and group behavior for protection. Some hide, others rely on safety in numbers. Even venomous animals must stay alert. From top predators to bottom feeders, each species has evolved unique strategies. Defense includes toxins, teeth, mimicry, and camouflage. Nudibranchs, clownfish, squid, octopus, and orcas are just a few winners in the underwater Race of Life, adapting brilliantly to their environment.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Insects may be small, but their survival strategies are fierce. They thrive in diverse environments thanks to their exoskeletons, which protect against impact, chemicals, and water. Wings help them escape danger or seek food and mates. Dragonflies hover and dart after prey, monarchs undergo stunning metamorphosis, and praying mantises blend into greenery before striking. Social insects like ants and bees live in colonies. From camouflage to flight, every adaptation helps insects stay in the Race of Life.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In this epic octopus adventure, Jonathan visits two aquaria to learn about the Giant Pacific octopus, and then travels to Seattle, Washington (USA) to join the Seattle Aquarium dive team on an octopus survey. He meets the Giant Pacific Octopus, the world's largest octopus, and discovers how clever this huge invertebrate really is!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan joins shark researcher Dr. Stephen Kajiura to test how well wild sharks can detect electrical fields in their environment. Then, he heads to New Jersey (USA) to learn how to dive in the Mark V commercial diving helmet! Finally, he ends up in the Gulf of Mexico to learn how oil platforms can actually become a healthy artificial reef and attract marine life from miles around.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: The Internet began in 1969 as a Cold War military tool for secure communication. Email followed in 1972. Decades later, Tim Berners-Lee introduced the World Wide Web, linking documents and revolutionizing public access. His idea, once called "vague but exciting," reshaped how we share, protest, and connect. Now, with Web 3.0 on the horizon, the Internet may evolve to understand human needs—what's next in this digital journey?

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Early computers include the Antikythera device and Babbage's engines, though his designs were ahead of their time. WWII accelerated the need for powerful calculators. Early machines were massive but weak. The invention of the transistor in the 1950s replaced bulky vacuum tubes, enabling personal computers. Today, supercomputers help design planes, buildings—even target genes. Computers are evolving fast—what's next?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: If you have ever gone to a hockey game, or gone ice-skating, there is one revolutionary machine that helps keep the fun and action going! And that's all thanks to the Zamboni® Ice Resurfacing Machine. You'll learn how and why it was invented! And ever notice some pistachio nuts are red in color? We'll throw up the red flag and explain why the color is simply a cover up!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: If you ever go camping there is one thing you do not want to leave home without, the swiss army knife! We'll explain how it evolved into the most famous knife in the world and how the company's name got "Cut" together! And where did the term "cup of Joe" come from as well as the word java? And we all love a juicy hamburger, so where did these chopped meat patties come from?

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: These are the the Moon's of the gas giants. Each a unique and mysterious world of its own. Some have oceans of water, geysers of Sulphur or atmospheres of plastic. Some are just now being seen at the outer rim of our solar system, all are worthy of much more scrutiny.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: It powers the machinery of nature; our weather, encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. When it sets in the West it reveals to us its many billions of sibling stars populating the night sky. We study our Sun closely, and like a Rosetta stone it can reveal the secrets of all the other stars above.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Vear is when visuals trigger imagined sounds, like the silent thud in the jumping pylon illusion. Retinal fatigue causes afterimages after staring at one color too long. The Müller-Lyer illusion tricks us into seeing equal lines as different lengths due to arrowheads. The Ames Room distorts size perception through skewed architecture. Synesthesia links senses—some people see colors when hearing sounds due to hyperconnected neurons.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Chromatic adaptation lets humans perceive consistent colors despite changing light. Some animals change color using chromatophores—for camouflage or signaling. Pink isn't a real wavelength; our brains create it by blending light. Blue is rare in nature but appears through structural features in feathers and wings. Snow camouflage helps animals blend into winter landscapes using shades of white and gray.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Rip Files

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: In this episode we explore Las Vegas' lesser known past. We visit the National Atomic Testing museum to learn about how the desert outside of Vegas was used for testing America's secret nuclear weapons. We also visit the Mormon Fort, the first permanent non-native settlement in the area, as well as the Neon Museum.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: It's island living in the Keys on this episode of TTH. We learn about the islands treasure hunting history at the Mel Fisher Museum. Then we'll explore Fort Jefferson, an isolated fort in the Gulf of Mexico that defended the islands. American literature enthusiasts will enjoy a look at Ernest Hemingway's Key West home, where some of his most famous works were penned.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it's maybe more interesting than you think?

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature's heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let's look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Fishing Prince Rupert, Ha-Nee-Nah Lodge on Dundas Island and Hecate Strait for Chinook Salmon and Pacific Halibut!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Bangalore is a city with many names: the Garden City, the Pub City, the Fashion Capital the list goes on. Follow Bill as he journeys through this city of contrasts and touches on its many faces. We visit Cubbon Park and Lal Bagh Gardens, shop in the markets and explore the nightlife of the modern city. We also explore architecture, from ancient Bull Temple, the legendary source of the Vishva Bharti River to the largest legislative building in India. Bill's final stop is the "Queen of the Hill Stations" Ooty, where he tours the plantations, rides the historic narrow-gauge railroad and visits the Stone House, which was built by the British in the days of colonial rule.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: These two national parks have some of the most diverse wildlife found on the Indian subcontinent. From the ancestors of our domesticated livestock to leopards, bear and elephants—this is a photographer's paradise. Join Bill as he attempts to track down two of the hardest predators to photograph—the leopard and the sloth bear.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: All the essentials for going on, and having a successful safari are covered before our host gets a very special challenge—to find at least half of the "Big Twelve" on one safari drive. Four hours and six (6) very special animals—can he do it using his own rules for a successful safari?

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: We elect to stay on a few extra days to try and obtain some good leopard footage. These are the most elusive of the "Big Twelve" and filming them is a major challenge. In the process of tracking leopards, we run across a newborn gazelle trying to walk for the first time. Will it succeed before the predators find it? Can we find and film a leopard up close?

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The question often rises is the cost of space exploration really worth it? Could the money be better spent elsewhere. If so one space program would have to remain. The planetary defence program, to locate identify and deflect a wayward asteroid from hitting Earth and destroying our civilzation because at last count there were 15,000 possible dangerous candidates close to Earth.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: For an instrument first developed as recently as the 17th century, the telescope has travelled a long way. The latest version of the once-humble telescope will be going a lot farther _ carrying us ever closer to the first light that ever bathed the Universe in which we live.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Learn how almond nuts get transformed into "milk." And why are movie trailers shown at the beginning of the film? We'll keep your attention so you'll want to stick around for the answer. And learn how detergents make your clothes seem brighter and whiter.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Learn how a pharmacist and an accountant created the most famous drink in the world, coca cola! And, learn the "Bear" truth behind how a U.S. president helped create everyone's favorite stuffed toy, The Teddy Bear! Then, how did a piece of wire accidentally "Slink" its way to become a fantastic fun toy for children? Plus, how a the wiffle ball was invented.

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories
programme.desc: Water: H2O Stories is a 3x52 series revisiting the story of water on planet Earth and its disrupted course over time which has led to the 21st century biggest challenge.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: A snapshot of Seasons, how they work together and keep the globe in balance. Droughts are explored in terms of how we can predict them, proof our lives from them and collect data because of them. Hurricanes are explained, their power revealed and the measures that are used to help us survive their impact. Thunderstorms have a few stages of development that roll out in a particular order.

programme.title: Nadijina američka avantura
programme.desc: Nadija Husein putuje u Ameriku, upoznaje se sa velikom raznolikošću lokalne kulture vezane za hranu i istražuje kako najskoriji migranti menjaju nacionalni meni.

programme.title: Džejmi i Džimi u gastronomskom izazovu
programme.desc: Džejmiju i Džimiju pridružuje se britanski glumac Vovrik Dejvis. Na meniju je govedina i pita od sira stilton. Džejmi zatim sprema vijetnamski po, a Džimi peče svinjetinu na ražnju.

programme.title: Donalova porodična kuhinja
programme.desc: Donal veruje da je hrana smisao života! Sa dvoje dece teško je biti vrhunski kuvar, posebno kad se približava kraj nedelje i kada manjka energije. Veoma je važno servirati ukusnu, zdravu hranu u što kraćem roku. Donal ima četiri recepta baš za to.

programme.title: Donalova porodična kuhinja
programme.desc: Svake godine, Donal planira božićnu trpezu za svoju porodicu i svaki put želi da proba nešto novo. Tako je bilo sve do prošlog Božića, kada je odlučio da se drži proverenih recepata. Taj Božić je bio najbolji dotad.

programme.title: Farmerska radnja u Kotsvoldu
programme.desc: Ove nedelje, upravnik Nuno ide u pekaru kod Orija, da bi proširio asortiman peciva i ugostio kupce koji ne jedu životinjske proizvode. Aleks je na putu da bi otkrio kako se prave rolnice sa kobasicama. Jesen dolazi i Sara smišlja novu poslasticu.

programme.title: Stenli Tuči: U potrazi za Italijom
programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi, Stenli Tuči odlazi u Pulju, regiju poznatu po maslinovom ulju, povrću, sirevima i durum pšenici. Iako je regija veoma plodna, Pulja je jedna od najsiromašnijih u Italiji i Stenli otkriva da su inovacije nastale zbog teškog života.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Lora i Stojan će da usreće sve ljubitelje čorbe od škembića, tako što će napraviti meksičku verziju ovo jela, poznatog kao menudo.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi, Lora i Stojan će podeliti dva recepta za punjene sarmice, jedne sa listom kupusa a druge sa listovima vinove loze. U jelima neće biti mesa, ali neće biti ništa lošija zbog toga. Za kraj spremaju baklavu kakvu pravi Stojanova majka.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Lora i Stojan podeliće dva recepta iz nekoliko delova, koji zahtevaju vreme za pripremu ali su odlični. Spremaju pileće rolade sa bogatim punjenjem, skuvane u sosu od paradajza sa prilogom od pariskih njoka.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Palenta sa čvarcima i sirom, jelo koje pamtimo od svojih baka, inspiriše Loru i Stojana da prave kulinarske eksperimente. Spremiće i laki ukiseljeni celer i paprike i za kraj pitu od jabuka.

programme.title: Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Pati istražuje najveću meksičku državu uranjajući u njenu kulinarsku dušu. Ova kuhinja se ističe oskudnim, ali divnim sastojcima, kreativnošću i sa puno začina. Budite spremni za avanture koje prevazilaze okvire tanjira i upoznavanje duha Čihuahue.

programme.title: Donal Skijan: Kuvamo kod kuće

programme.title: Donal Skijan: Kuvamo kod kuće

programme.title: Farmerska radnja u Kotsvoldu
programme.desc: Nuno ide u porodični restoran da proširi ponudu italijanskih delikatesa. Dejv ide da pregleda stoku da bi se uverio u kvalitet mesa. Ketrin slavi sezonu bundeva. Ide na farmu kako bi došla kako do nadahnuća tako i do bundeva svih oblika i veličina.

programme.title: Pecite sa Akisom

programme.title: Pecite sa Akisom

programme.title: Džejms Martin: Španska avantura
programme.desc: U regiji Kosta del Sol Džejms otkriva kako se pravi džinovska paelja i obilazi jedno selo. Odlazi u voćnjak citrusa i otkriva kako nastaje sladoled moskatel. Priprema andaluzijski pirinač s prženom ribom, piletinu, tapase i teletinu.

programme.title: Đino u Italiji: Tajne juga
programme.desc: Đino se vraća u Bazilikatu, kako bi istražio Polino, najveći nacionalni park Italije. Ovo je jedna od najbrdovitijih regija, gde su se doselile albanske izbeglice, bežeći od Turaka pre 500 godina. Njihovi potomci danas žive u predivnoj izolaciji.

programme.title: Đino u Italiji: Tajne juga
programme.desc: U poslednjoj epizodi serijala, Đino se vraća u Bari i grad Čisternino, kako bi otkrio italijansku riblju alternativu engleskoj ćuretini. Đino odlazi na pijacu u potrazi za ribom, koju će pripremiti u okviru svoje južnoitalijanske božićne gozbe.

programme.title: Adam i Po: Malezija u Australiji - Ukusni australijski obroci
programme.desc: Adam i Po odlaze u regiju Gipsland u Australiji, da bi otkrili ljubav prema jednostavnoj domaćoj hrani i pokušali da pripreme najbolji australijski porodični obrok.

programme.title: Adam i Po: Malezija u Australiji - Ukusni australijski obroci
programme.desc: U svakom regionalnom gradiću u Australiji, moguće je naći tri ključna dela australijske kulture i kuhinje, a to su: bar, pekara i restoran kineske hrane.

programme.title: Džejmi Oliver: Mediteranski obroci od 5 sastojaka
programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi, Džejmi koristi zamrznutu ribu da uštedi na vremenu, novcu i planiranju, i pravi brzi zalogaj koji u fokus stavlja zamrznuto povrće, kao i dva bogata jela od sastojaka iz špajza. Zatim Đenaro Kontaldo pravi njoke od pet sastojaka.

programme.title: Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Pati istražuje najveću meksičku državu uranjajući u njenu kulinarsku dušu. Ova kuhinja se ističe oskudnim, ali divnim sastojcima, kreativnošću i sa puno začina. Budite spremni za avanture koje prevazilaze okvire tanjira i upoznavanje duha Čihuahue.

programme.title: Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Pati se vraća kući u Meksiko Siti, deleći svoje srce, dušu i ukuse u sezoni punoj ljubavi.
